caseNameFull: Eastland et ux. v. Campbell, District Director of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Allen E. Pye and J. Robt. Dobbs, Jr. for petitioners., Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Oberdorfer, Meyer Rothwacks and Harold C. Wilkenfeld for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
